headline: Rain and landslides: Bridge collapses on Rangamati-Bandarban road, cutting off link
summary: Direct road communication between the two districts has been completely severed after a bridge in Rangunia Upazila collapsed due to heavy rain and mountain torrents.
details: A bridge in the Dudhpukuria area of Padua Union, Rangunia Upazila, collapsed during the night on Friday following continuous rainfall and mountain torrents.
The collapse has completely severed direct road communication between Rangamati and Bandarban districts, leaving thousands of commuters stranded on both sides.

Local residents and road department sources report that intense currents of mountain torrents caused a rubber dam's embankment to break, leading to a portion of the bridge collapsing under the pressure of the water.
The bridge falls under the jurisdiction of the Bandarban Roads and Highways Department, despite being located in Rangunia Upazila.
Bandarban RHD Executive Engineer Md. Sakhawat Hossain stated that his team has not yet reached the site because roads and bridges in the Balaghata and Swarnomandir areas are submerged in water.
The department plans to install a Bailey bridge to restore traffic as soon as the water levels recede.

The bridge falls under the jurisdiction of the Bandarban Roads and Highways Department, despite being located in Rangunia Upazila.

Bandarban RHD Executive Engineer Md. Sakhawat Hossain stated that his team has not yet reached the site because roads and bridges in the Balaghata and Swarnomandir areas are submerged in water.

The department plans to install a Bailey bridge to restore traffic as soon as the water levels recede.

headline_marked: [[Heavy rainfall]] forecast for 5 divisions, maritime ports warned
headline: Heavy rainfall forecast for 5 divisions, maritime ports warned
summary: Bangladesh Meteorological Department predicts rain with thunderstorms across the country for the next five days. Maritime ports have been advised to lower signal.
details: The Bangladesh Meteorological Department (BMD) has issued a five-day forecast predicting rain and thunderstorms across the country. Five divisions are expected to experience heavy rainfall.
In light of the forecast, maritime ports have been advised to lower their signal. This advisory is a precautionary measure to ensure safety at sea.
The forecast indicates that light to moderate rain is likely to occur in many parts of the country. However, some areas may experience very heavy downpours, particularly in the specified divisions.
caption:
Heavy rain and thunderstorms are expected across Bangladesh for the next five days. Maritime ports have been warned.

The Bangladesh Meteorological Department (BMD) has issued a five-day forecast predicting rain and thunderstorms across the country. Five divisions are expected to experience heavy rainfall.

In light of the forecast, maritime ports have been advised to lower their signal. This advisory is a precautionary measure to ensure safety at sea.

The forecast indicates that light to moderate rain is likely to occur in many parts of the country. However, some areas may experience very heavy downpours, particularly in the specified divisions.
